dataList.content:
Lady Faust, however similar in appearance they may have been to the passengers...
浮士德小姐，这些人……虽然是乘客的样子……
dataList.place:
WARP Train Economy Class Cabin
WARP列车 经济舱 车厢

dataList.content:
... Verily, 'tis as though they were in complete want of sense...
却像是一群无法明辨是非，也不存在理性的人……

Like people pallidified by the Whale...
就像是被那头鲸所白化了一样……

Don Quixote, who hesitated until the last second to raise her weapon against them, hung her head mournfully.
直到最后还在犹豫是否要与他们战斗的堂吉诃德沮丧地低下了头。

Normally...
若是像往常一样……

Faust would have told her more information about those monsters before the fight began.
在开战之前，浮士德应该会把这些要面对的人的信息告诉堂吉诃德了吧。

And she would not have been burdened by the sheer thought of bringing harm to the innocent.
若是如此，堂吉诃德就不会抱着会杀害无辜者的想法参加战斗了吧。

Faust began searching the area, closely observing various bodies and the general area for information.
浮士德环视四周，开始了搜索。

You appear particularly inquisitive today, Miss Faust.
你今日似乎格外注意四周，浮士德女士。

Huh, yeah. Aren't you usually the one who has all the answers while we're wracking our brains trying to come up with something?
没错。要在平时，你肯定在我们还在观察的时候就已经得出结论了吧？

The Sinners were starting to realize that there was something off about Faust's behavior...
罪人们一个两个，都开始觉得浮士德有和平常不同的违和感……

They might even soon realize that there's something wrong with Faust.
这样下去，他们早晚会发现浮士德身上出了问题。

... Don Quixote.
……堂吉诃德。

They are not dead.
这些人没有死去。

... Huhh?
……嗯？

Observe closer. The parts are all tethered to one another by something, are they not?
请仔细看看。你能看见碎片与碎片之间被什么东西连在一起了对吧？

Ooho!
啊啊……！

It appears that the flow of time has ceased in this space. Therefore, it follows that the... connections, that tether bodies to life and away from death, remain intact.
此处空间的时间似乎是静止的。因此，没有导致死亡的……断裂产生，躯体间仍保持着联系。

To my relief...
万幸的是……

... Faust managed to correctly figure out what's going on like her usual self, even if it took her slightly longer than it usually does.
虽然花了一段时间，但浮士德还是如往常那样提供了信息。

<Hey, what'd I say? We got this...!>
<你看，我说过我们能做到的……！>

Huh? What was that about?
嗯？你说什么？

<O-oh, nothing...>
<没、没什么……>

But... I'd forgotten that not all Sinners were content with nodding along to whatever information Faust told us.
但是……也有没那么好骗的罪人。

The flow of time is ceased aboard a WARP train, is it...?
时间停滞了是吗……

Yi Sang grew pensive. Seeing that, Faust's lips parted for a moment before closing shut.
看到李箱突然陷入了思索，浮士德的嘴唇微微动了一下。

I was starting to get a good read of her expressions. That was an unmistakable look of regret, however short-lived.
相处久了我也开始了解她了。……虽然只有一瞬间，但那是“糟了”的表情。

Howbeit, would it not be more accurate to muse that the flow of time has decelerated to the point where, to an extradimensional observer, it has slowed to a stop? What is your perspective regarding this suggestion?
此处的时间缓慢到了从这个次元外观测近乎停止的程度……是不是这么看比较好。

Yes. That is a most rational suggestion, Yi Sang.
是的。李箱先生的意见很合理。

Uh... Did Miss Faust just get something wrong?
欸……浮士德小姐也有犯错的时候吗？

<W-wow, Yi Sang sure is the expert when it comes to time-related phenomena. Can you summarize it in easier language now that we're broaching the subject?>
<李、李箱果然是时间现象领域的专家呢。都这样了，李箱能不能顺便更为详细地解释一下呢？>

Ah. Gladly, if you would allow me.
哦，我很乐意，如果您允许的话。

Yi Sang began to elaborate with gentle enthusiasm.
李箱似乎有些高兴地继续说道。

... That was close.
……这样就放心了。

To speak in brevity, it can be said that death is not an element aboard this train.
简而言之，死亡并不在此班列车之上。

And...? Can ya maybe speak in a little less brevity?
是不是省略得有点多了……？

Ah, to elaborate...
啊，补充一下……

... Ah, verily! This one's heart beats still!
……确有其事！此人的心脏仍在跳动！

Don Quixote lowered her head and listened closely to what appeared to be a dismembered torso... and shouts with relief.
堂吉诃德看上去像是在侧耳聆听碎片之中的躯干，然后释然般地大叫道。

Their state is akin to an unassembled jigsaw puzzle; merely immobilized and separated.
他们就如同分散的拼图碎片、无法活动，仅仅只能在地上翻滚。

Though their corpus has been sundered, the concept of death is at a state of, for all intents and purposes, eternal delay aboard this train, existence in continuance of moratorium...
身体分离的过程已然进行，但这辆列车上的存在却会被保留，并被不断延续……

Forced, they are, to be tethered upon the thinnest yet tenacious thread of life.
因此他们只是握有即使无限变细也不会断裂的生命之丝，如此散落着。

Mm... I ill understand what hath been said here, yet they are not dead all the same, hm?
虽然吾不是很理解复杂的解释……总之他们没有死吧！

If their severed parts are all connected... then it can be said that no matter how entangled their bodies become, it is not impossible to eventually gather their parts together to form a single passenger.
这些人的碎片各自连接在一起，这意味着不管如何混杂，只要沿着连接碎片的线将它们收集起来，就能一一锁定乘客。

Thus, naturally, we can determine how and why the profession "W Corp. Cleanup Agent" has come to be.
自然……我们便可以推定W公司清扫人员这一职位产生的理由。

I see. Because someone will have to categorize and reconstruct these puzzles once the journey is over.
是因为需要有人将这些拼图区分并组装起来……

<It's really baffling to me that a job like that even exists...>
<因为那种事就产生了这个职业，有些残酷了……>

Ever seen a Wing that wasn't baffling in every sense of the word?
翼所做的事情有什么是不残酷的吗？

<Still... I guess that means that, as long as the train arrives at the station, the passengers will all be put back together like nothing happened.>
<但是……如果这趟列车最终到站的话，乘客们会被全部分类，像是无事发生一般恢复原样的吧？>

From what I learned through the W Corp. Identities, their main job was to gather chunks of flesh together to bring them back to their original shapes before they boarded the trains.
回想起人格们所说的话，他们都做着收集碎片，让乘客恢复到刚刚乘车时的状态的工作。

It's a lot more visceral when I have to look at it in person...
作为亲眼所见的感想，我觉得这很残酷……

Phew... that is quite the auspicious news among ill tidings indeed.
呼……听闻这话吾就安心了。

It soon clicked in me what Faust was, though with some awkward effort, trying to do as I watched Don Quixote sigh with relief.
看着松了一口气的堂吉诃德，虽然浮士德有些笨拙，但我明白了她刚刚想要说什么。

Maybe Faust was trying to cheer Don Quixote up in her own way.
也许现在的浮士德想用自己的方式去安慰堂吉诃德。

Who she was a while ago would not find it even necessary to do something like that...
如果是之前的浮士德，会觉得这个行为根本没有必要……

Dante.
但丁。

<Huh? What's up?>
<怎么了？>

<Oh. Time to whisper, right?>
<啊，是要说秘密吗。>

... Indeed. I intend to collect further intelligence.
……对，我在收集信息。

<Well, if there's anything I can tell you...>
<如果我能回答上来的话……>

Faust cast a dark gaze toward the chunks of flesh. Her gaze remained fixed upon them as she whispered.
浮士德眼神阴郁地看了一会儿碎片的方位，就那么盯着，然后低语道。

Are they Distortions, or... Abnormalities?
它们是扭曲，还是异想体呢？

<Oh... yeah. I actually wanted to ask you about that.>
<啊……我也正想问你呢。>

They weren't humans, that was for sure. From them, I felt the same sensation I felt from monsters.
这些东西和人类也不一样……所以我有一种在怪物身上感受到的感觉。

Something inexplicable. An unclear sensation or an aura.
没法解释的模糊感觉，或者说是感受。

I've felt this somewhere before, I'm sure of it. But... I couldn't quite pinpoint the source of this sensation.
我之前确实在哪里有过这种感觉……但不清楚具体位置在哪。

One thing I do know for sure is that this sensation was not the same feeling I got from Abnormalities, Distortions, or even the Peccatula.
可以确定的是，这和从异想体和扭曲……以及罪种身上感受到的氛围完全不同。

<If I had to lean one way or the other, I'd say they're... closer to Distortions.>
<非要说的话……和扭曲的感觉比较接近。>

<I'm sorry, I don't think they're either of those.>
<抱歉，但总之我觉得不是其中任何一种。>

Is it difficult to be certain at the moment?
不能确定吗？

<Again, I'm not sure how I can explain this, but they're very, very similar to Distortions. But also... different.>
<虽然很难解释……虽然其和扭曲十分相似……但就是不同。>

<If you had to ask, then... I'm gonna guess Faust doesn't know?>
<不过你会这么问我……也就是说浮士德不知道吧。>

Faust may know... but I, at this moment, have no way of knowing.
如果是浮士德的话，也许会知道……但至少现在的我并不清楚。

<... I feel like I should apologize for that.>
<……我总觉得很抱歉。>

There is no need, Dante.
没必要这么想，但丁。

Though the information you have provided me is rather ambiguous, it has helped me deduce something of worth.
虽然这是不确定的信息，但我也因此得出了一个推论。

And...
还有……

Collecting intelligence myself and creating deductions based on sparse information is quite...
亲手收集信息以得出合乎逻辑的结论也比预想中要……

She paused, holding a bloody, slimy chunk of flesh in her hands.
浮士德手中握着肉块碎片说道。

... Did she just smile to herself with gore in her hands?
……那家伙刚才是不是一个人拿着肉块笑起来了？

Hooh. Finally, the awakening has begun.
嚯，终于觉醒了吗。
